requirements.title: The listed events make a pointer become associated
requirements.definition: A pointer becomes associated after successful ALLOCATE of the pointer, pointer assignment to an associated or valid TARGET target, SOURCE= allocation of an object with corresponding associated pointer subobject, dummy pointer association with a nonpointer actual, or default initialization of a pointer subcomponent to a non-NULL target through INTENT(OUT), unsaved local, BLOCK local, or allocation events.

pending.allocate-pointer-associated: Pointer p starts NULL and ASSOCIATED(p) false; ALLOCATE(p); ASSOCIATED(p) true, assignment p=42, and reading p exact 42 prove allocated association.
pending.pointer-assignment-associated-target: Targets a=1 and pointer q=>a; p starts NULL, p=>q, then ASSOCIATED(p,a) true and p exact 1 prove association through associated pointer target.
pending.pointer-assignment-target-attribute: Target integer t=42; p starts NULL, p=>t, ASSOCIATED(p,t) true and p exact 42 prove association to TARGET object.
pending.pointer-assignment-allocated-allocatable: Allocatable TARGET integer a is allocated, set to 42, then p=>a; ASSOCIATED(p,a) true and p exact 42 prove allocated-allocatable target association.
pending.source-allocate-associated-pointer-subob: Type box has pointer component p; source object src%p=>target t=42; ALLOCATE(dst,SOURCE=src) yields ASSOCIATED(dst%p,t) true and dst%p exact 42.
pending.dummy-pointer-nonpointer-actual-associat: Subroutine with pointer dummy p is called with nonpointer TARGET actual t=1; inside, ASSOCIATED(p,t) true, p=42, and exact post-call t=42 prove association.
pending.default-initialized-component-intent-out: Type box has pointer component default-initialized to module target t=42, not NULL; procedure with nonpointer nonallocatable INTENT(OUT) dummy b observes ASSOCIATED(b%p,t) true and b%p exact 42.
pending.default-initialized-component-unsaved-lo: Invoking a procedure with unsaved local box b default-initialized to target t=42 observes ASSOCIATED(b%p,t) true and b%p exact 42.
pending.default-initialized-component-block-loca: Entering BLOCK with unsaved local box b default-initialized to target t=42 observes ASSOCIATED(b%p,t) true and b%p exact 42.
pending.default-initialized-component-allocated-: ALLOCATE(box :: b) for a type whose pointer component default-initializes to target t=42 observes ASSOCIATED(b%p,t) true and b%p exact 42.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.
